takeaway: Noise-cancelling headphones use microphones to detect external noise and then generate an 'anti-noise' sound wave—an exact opposite—to cancel out unwanted sounds before they reach your ear, creating astonishing quiet.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your noise-cancelling headphones literally fight sound with sound? 🤯

💡 Noise-cancelling headphones use microphones to detect external noise and then generate an 'anti-noise' sound wave—an exact opposite—to cancel out unwanted sounds before they reach your ear, creating astonishing quiet.
